name: Handles & Drive Passing
summary: Warm up your handle low, read and pass off the drive, finish off the wrong foot, then push your handle through sprint intervals.

drills.name: Kneeling Dribble Series
drills.summary: Get your fingertips warm with the ball close to the floor.
steps: Kneel on one knee and pound the ball hard with your right hand for 20 seconds.
Switch to your left hand for 20 seconds.
Do side-to-side dribbles in front of your knee, then switch hands.
Finish with crossovers in front of you, as quick as you can control.
Switch knees and repeat the full series.

drills.name: Wall Target Drive Passes
drills.equipment: 1 ball, 1 cone, tape or chalk, a wall
drills.summary: Attack, read the help, and hit a target on the move.
steps: Mark two targets on a wall: one high on the left, one low on the right.
Set a cone at the free throw line as the help defender.
Drive at the cone and call out 'high' or 'low' before you reach it.
Pass to the target you called with one hand off the dribble.
Alternate hands and change which target you call each rep.

drills.name: Same-Foot Layup Series
drills.summary: Finish off the 'wrong' foot to beat shot blockers' timing.
steps: From the right wing, drive and jump off your right foot for a right-hand layup.
Do 5 makes, then switch to the left side, left foot, left hand.
Next, take off from the inside foot and finish with the outside hand.
Keep the ball high and away from where a defender would reach.
Finish with 5 makes per side at game speed.

drills.name: 30-30 Sideline Dribble Sprints
drills.summary: Hold a clean handle while you are tired.
steps: Start on one sideline with the ball.
Speed dribble to the other sideline and back for 30 seconds.
Count your trips out loud.
Rest for 30 seconds, then go again.
Do 4 rounds and try to beat your trip count each round.
Use your weak hand on rounds 2 and 4.
